audit_items.proof_trace: When `debt_amount (ceil of stored Decimal) <= amount`, `debt.cleared()` zeroes the stored amount, after which `has_debt()` returns false and `wit_table::remove` is called unconditionally. The `unsafe_decrease` path cannot produce a zero amount because `ceil(stored_amount) > amount` and `stored_amount - amount > 0` are jointly guaranteed by the ceiling-based branch condition. Both callers (`repay_debt` and `liquidation_inner`) accrue interest before calling this function, so the stored amount is always current.
